answer_1.quote: Sequential neural network architectures in their various forms have become the mainstay in abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of summaries through ROUGE F-1 scores ) by counting the unigram (R-1), bigram (R-2) and longest common subsequence (R-L) overlaps. To avoid the use of pure lexical overlap evaluation , we also use BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We also invited human referees from Amazon Mechanical Turk to assess our model and additional three pure abstractive baselines including BERTSUMABS, T5-Large, BART on CNN/DM testing set.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the referees to choose the best and worst summaries from the four candidates for each criterion.
